name: JETNET
description:
JETNET MCP gives Claude direct, read-only access to JETNET's business
aviation intelligence database, so you can ask questions in plain language instead
of writing SQL or exporting spreadsheets.

_published_faq.name: How do I add JETNET to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add JETNET to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.jetnet.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the JETNET MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: JETNET provides these MCP tools: evolution-mcp___execute_sql, evolution-mcp___get_current_utc_time, evolution-mcp___get_database_tables, and evolution-mcp___get_table_column_details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to JETNET?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to JETNET in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
JETNET requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
JETNET is developed by JETNET. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
